text:
Alex Chen: FYI — Customer 'BrightHealth' asked for a single endpoint that can do chat + retrieval-augmented rerank + embeddings in one flow for their provider search bakeoff. They want <200ms p95 for simple queries and fallback quality on complex ones.
Priya Nair: thanks — do we have a proposed variant? Is this basically fusion endpoint + rerank pass?
Alex Chen: yes, idea is: chat-completions primary -> embeddings for doc recall -> light rerank (cheap scoring model) -> full rerank only on ambiguous cases. keep cheap path hot.
Sam Patel: latency/cost sketch: cheap rerank ~ +4ms, full rerank +40-60ms depending on model. embeddings call adds ~20-40ms w/ cache. Need numbers per model.
Marco Ruiz: acceptance criteria proposal: 1) p95 end-to-end <= 200ms for 70% of queries, 2) quality delta vs current prod rerank within 3% on eval set, 3) graceful fallback to full rerank when ambiguity > threshold, 4) per-customer config flags.
Liza Gomez: edge cases to call out: queries with long context ( > 2048 tokens), doc-store cold reads, and mixed-language inputs. also security: ensure PII is redacted before embeddings.
Alex Chen: routing policy sketch — prefer cached embeddings + cheap reranker. if confidence < 0.6 run full rerank. Example config: 
```
variant_policy: 
  - name: cheap-path
    when: embeddings_cached == true AND confidence >= 0.6
    model: cheap-rerank-v1
  - name: full-rerank
    when: confidence < 0.6 OR tokens > 1024
    model: rerank-v2
```
Priya Nair: can we add a canary plan? Suggest 10% traffic for 1 day, monitor quality and token-cost. fallback rule: if cost/run > 1.5x baseline or quality drops > 5pts abort.
Sam Patel: quick perf test ask: can eng-runtime run a synthetic workload that mixes 60% short queries, 30% medium, 10% long? measure p50/p95/end-to-end and per-stage breakdown (embeddings, cheap-rerank, full-rerank). @deploy-bot can we schedule?
deploy-bot: scheduled perf job: rerank-fusion-bakeoff-2026-03-25, 4h run, captures per-stage traces and token counts.
Marco Ruiz: QA checklist: eval set (customer-provided + internal slice), include adversarial prompts, multilingual subset, and a replay of live traffic sample. Also add regression alerts on top-N ranking drift.
Liza Gomez: testing note — we need an embedding normalization step in pipeline to avoid vector-shift across quantized models. call it out in spec.
Alex Chen: next steps: 1) Priya to lock acceptance criteria + canary window by EOD Wed, 2) Eng-runtime to run perf job and share traces, 3) Marco/Liza to prepare eval sets and QA plan. I'll draft a short PRD and drop in the thread for review. :thumbsup:
Priya Nair: ack — will sync with customer on acceptable SLOs. adding follow-ups to calendar.
Sam Patel: will prepare cost sensitivity spreadsheet (tokens, model choices, batching effects).
Alex Chen: thanks all — we should aim to have a canary-ready build by next week.
